title: Cabin
body:

Kitchen should be larger than living room.
Dog.
2 kids?
Raspberry — six plants.

title: Rule
body:
A system can be lawful and still be wrong.
A person can break the law and still save someone.
Neither sentence cancels the other.

title: Инээд
body: Тэр инээхээр хэдхэн секунд энэ бүх юм зүгээр юм шиг болдог.
